name: Bombfighters
author: Patbox
description: A player-vs-player battle inspired by the multiplayer modes of 2D Bomberman games: drop bombs and blow up your opponents. Needs several gamepads.

descriptions.en: A player-vs-player battle inspired by the multiplayer modes of 2D Bomberman games: drop bombs and blow up your opponents. Needs several gamepads.
descriptions.it: Sfida tra giocatori ispirata alle modalità multigiocatore dei Bomberman 2D: piazza le bombe e fai saltare in aria gli avversari. Servono più joypad.
